category: Small things that hit different as an adult
quote: You know you are an adult when a clean kitchen brings peace. Buying a high-quality sponge feels like a genuine financial investment. Having a Friday night with absolutely zero plans is the ultimate luxury. Suddenly, you get genuinely excited about a new set of hangers. Turns out, my biggest childhood dream was just living in a tidy house.
